entry.title: ProofTTL — Source-Backed Claim Verification
entry.summary: ProofTTL verifies consequential AI and human-written claims against source evidence. The $299 Rapid Claim Check covers up to five public, redacted, or de-identified claims with human-reviewed results and a 24-hour turnaround.

entry.title: ProofTTL Fact Audit
entry.summary: The $1,500 fixed-scope Fact Audit reviews up to 25 real outputs or claims, deep-verifies the highest-risk findings, requires human approval, and includes a seven-day evidence watch.

entry.title: AI Fact Checker — Verify Claims With Sources
entry.summary: ProofTTL checks consequential AI-generated factual claims against public evidence and returns explicit SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, or UNKNOWN verdicts.
